title: Find the full name of the player who is among the lightest (under 130 weigh
question: Find the full name of the player who is among the lightest (under 130 weight), played in 2010–2015, and has the highest average overall rating during that period.

prediction.sql:
SELECT P.XCL_123
FROM Player AS P
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.XCL_122 = PA.XCL_130
WHERE P.XCL_127 < 130
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', PA.XCL_131) BETWEEN '2010' AND '2015'
GROUP BY P.XCL_121, P.XCL_123
ORDER BY AVG(PA.XCL_132) DESC
LIMIT 1
